summary: Resolve setuptools dynamic version file in publication observer

delivery.outcome: Resolve supported static setuptools dynamic version files (tool.setuptools.dynamic.version.file) in goal.publish.state.plan_current_project while keeping version consistency, --verify-source artifact checks, and fail-closed security boundaries intact.

architecture.decision: Read static pyproject.toml metadata and safely resolve bounded relative tool.setuptools.dynamic.version.file values (str or 1-item list) only when build-backend is setuptools.build_meta without backend-path and symlinks/attr/traversal are absent.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit through protected review; preserve original repository metadata and dependency pins.

nonGoals: Do not execute Python code or resolve tool.setuptools.dynamic.version.attr
Do not modify pyproject.toml, uv.lock, heyasa/goal.yaml, or protected publication authority

validation.evidence: Dynamic setuptools file declarations (str, 1-item list, nested path) resolve package version and pending state without mutating the repo.
Version source drift, --verify-source comparison, and fail-closed rejection of unsafe paths/symlinks/attr/backends pass.
Repository governance and independent CI/Validator checks pass.
